learning_objective: 🎯 Master the amazing skill of hitting a ball with a bat or racket using perfect timing, super focus, and a powerful swing!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Hold your bat or racket firmly with both hands but do not squeeze too tightly. Your hands should be close together to give you maximum swinging power!
Keep your eyes totally locked on the ball from the moment it leaves the bowler's hand until it perfectly meets the center of your bat.
Step towards the ball, twist your hips, and swing your bat all the way through! A great follow-through gives the ball maximum speed.

fun_activity.title: 🎈 The Balloon Smash Game
fun_activity.instructions: Roll up an old newspaper to make a soft bat. Ask a friend to toss a balloon in the air and practice your best swings to smash the balloon across the room!

quick_recap: ⭐ Hold the bat firmly and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart for great balance.
⭐ Never take your eyes off the moving object until you feel it hit your bat.
⭐ Rotate your body and swing completely to send the ball flying far away!
